name: wf-postmortem
description: wf postmortem pack: the postmortem capability, a presence-only feature that ships a guided skill turning a maintainer's prose failure report into an explicit, echoed hunt scope plus a fixed-shape report skeleton. Owns no provider surface and attaches no phase fragment — it ships inert until registered and behaves identically whether or not it is. This slice resolves scope only; locating and reading sessions, verification, fix direction, and cap enforcement arrive with later charter sub-tasks. Ships /wf-postmortem:postmortem, the guided skill, plus /wf-postmortem:init for one-command self-registration.
